task.title: Installing Red Hat Enterprise Linux
task.shortdesc: This procedure describes how to install RHEL 9 on a bare-metal server.

prereq.p: Before you begin, ensure that your system meets the minimum hardware requirements.

context.p: You can install using several methods. This procedure covers the standard graphical installation from a USB drive.

step.cmd: Download the 9 ISO image from the Customer Portal.

info.p: You can choose between a full DVD ISO or a minimal boot ISO. For most installations, the full DVD ISO is recommended.

step.cmd: Create a bootable USB drive using the dd command.

info.note: This command will erase all data on the target device. Double-check the device path before running.

step.cmd: Boot the target system from the USB drive and select Install Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 from the boot menu.

info.p: You may need to change the boot order in the BIOS or UEFI firmware settings to boot from USB.

result.p: 9 is installed. The system reboots into the newly installed operating system.

postreq.p: After installation, register your system with Red Hat Subscription Manager by running subscription-manager register.
